<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<title>React + TypeScript Interview Mastery</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Atkinson+Hyperlegible+Next:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,700;1,400&family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,500..800&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  /* study-theme v4 "whiteboard": the one stylesheet every guide uses. Edit here, then run
     `npm run study:upgrade` to apply it to every guide (lib.upgrade swaps each guide's <style> for this file).
     Token names are also used inside the SVG diagrams (dg*.mjs), so rename none of them. */
  :root{
    /* light: a whiteboard. Navy ink, blue marker for actions, green for done, yellow highlighter. */
    --bg:#F5F7FA;
    --panel:#FFFFFF;
    --panel-2:#EEF2F7;
    --border:#D3DAE5;
    --text:#14213D;
    --muted:#4F5D78;
    --accent:#1B55C5;
    --accent-ink:#FFFFFF;
    --accent-soft:#E4EDFC;
    --gold:#7A5200;
    --gold-soft:#FFF1B8;
    --ok:#126B4B;
    --ok-soft:#DDF3E9;
    --code-bg:#EEF2F7;
    --danger:#B42318;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,33,61,.06), 0 4px 14px rgba(20,33,61,.04);
    --mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace;
    --sans: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
    --display: 'Bricolage Grotesque', var(--sans);
    --measure: 76ch;
  }
  @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark){
    :root:not([data-theme="light"]){
      /* dark: a chalkboard. Chalk white text, chalk blue / yellow / green accents. */
      --bg:#101A19;
      --panel:#17231F;
      --panel-2:#1E2D29;
      --border:#33493F;
      --text:#ECF1EE;
      --muted:#A9B8B1;
      --accent:#93BCFF;
      --accent-ink:#0A1730;
      --accent-soft:#1D3048;
      --gold:#F0CF6B;
      --gold-soft:#3A3216;
      --ok:#7FD6A8;
      --ok-soft:#173327;
      --code-bg:#0C1513;
      --danger:#F5A99C;
      --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
    }
  }
  :root[data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg:#101A19;
    --panel:#17231F;
    --panel-2:#1E2D29;
    --border:#33493F;
    --text:#ECF1EE;
    --muted:#A9B8B1;
    --accent:#93BCFF;
    --accent-ink:#0A1730;
    --accent-soft:#1D3048;
    --gold:#F0CF6B;
    --gold-soft:#3A3216;
    --ok:#7FD6A8;
    --ok-soft:#173327;
    --code-bg:#0C1513;
    --danger:#F5A99C;
    --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;}
  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;}
  html{color-scheme:light dark; scroll-padding-top:16px;}
  body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.6;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
    text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;
  }
  a{color:var(--accent); text-underline-offset:2px;}
  :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px; border-radius:4px;}
  ::selection{background:var(--gold-soft); color:var(--text);}

  .app{display:flex; min-height:100vh;}

  /* ---------- Sidebar ---------- */
  .sidebar{
    width:288px;
    flex:0 0 288px;
    border-right:1px solid var(--border);
    background:var(--panel);
    padding:18px 14px 24px;
    position:sticky;
    top:0;
    height:100vh;
    overflow-y:auto;
    scrollbar-width:thin;
  }
  .side-top{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:8px; margin:0 0 14px;}
  .home-link{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color:var(--muted); text-decoration:none; padding:6px 8px; border-radius:8px;}
  .home-link:hover{color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft);}
  .theme-btn{font:inherit; font-size:15px; line-height:1; width:34px; height:34px; color:var(--muted); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; cursor:pointer;}
  .theme-btn:hover{color:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent);}
  .brand{
    font-size:13.5px;
    line-height:1.45;
    color:var(--muted);
    padding:0 8px 16px;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
    margin-bottom:14px;
  }
  .brand b{display:block; font-family:var(--display); font-size:19px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.01em; color:var(--text);}
  .brand br{display:none;}
  .nav-item{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:space-between;
    gap:10px;
    width:100%;
    text-align:left;
    padding:9px 10px;
    border-radius:9px;
    border:1px solid transparent;
    background:transparent;
    color:var(--text);
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:15px;
    line-height:1.35;
    cursor:pointer;
    margin-bottom:2px;
  }
  .nav-item:hover{background:var(--panel-2);}
  .nav-item.active{background:var(--accent-soft); color:var(--text); font-weight:700; box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--accent);}
  .nav-num{font-size:12.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--muted); width:20px; flex:0 0 20px;}
  .nav-item.active .nav-num{color:var(--accent);}
  .nav-label{flex:1;}
  .nav-count{
    font-size:12px;
    font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
    color:var(--muted);
    background:var(--panel-2);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:1px 7px;
    border-radius:999px;
  }
  .nav-item.complete .nav-count{color:var(--ok); border-color:var(--ok); background:var(--ok-soft);}
  .progress-box{
    margin-top:20px;
    padding:14px 12px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:12px;
    background:var(--panel-2);
  }
  .progress-box .label{font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--muted); margin-bottom:8px; text-transform:lowercase;}
  .progress-box .label::first-letter{text-transform:uppercase;}
  .progress-track{height:8px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--border); overflow:hidden;}
  .progress-fill{height:100%; background:var(--ok); width:0%; transition:width .25s ease;}
  .progress-num{margin-top:8px; font-size:13.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--text);}
  .reset-btn{
    margin-top:10px;
    width:100%;
    font-family:var(--sans);
    font-size:13px;
    color:var(--muted);
    background:transparent;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:8px;
    padding:7px 8px;
    cursor:pointer;
  }
  .reset-btn:hover{color:var(--danger);border-color:var(--danger);}

  /* ---------- Main ---------- */
  .main{
    flex:1;
    min-width:0;
    padding:40px 48px 96px;
    max-width:1080px;
  }
  .hero{margin-bottom:36px;}
  .hero .eyebrow-free{display:none;}
  .hero h1{
    font-family:var(--display);
    font-size:clamp(28px, 3.4vw, 40px);
    line-height:1.12;
    margin:0 0 14px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:-0.02em;
    text-wrap:balance;
  }
  .hero p{color:var(--muted); max-width:68ch; margin:0 0 6px; font-size:16.5px;}
  .hero p strong{color:var(--text);}
  .hero .source-note{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); margin-top:18px; line-height:1.9;}

  .section-head{
    display:flex;
    align-items:baseline;
    gap:12px;
    margin:44px 0 14px;
    padding-bottom:12px;
    border-bottom:2px solid var(--text);
  }
  .section-head .num{font-family:var(--display); color:var(--accent); font-size:17px; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
  .section-head h2{font-family:var(--display); font-size:26px; line-height:1.2; margin:0; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.015em;}
  .section-head .count{margin-left:auto; font-size:13.5px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--muted); white-space:nowrap;}

  .qcard{
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:14px;
    background:var(--panel);
    margin-bottom:10px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .qcard:hover{border-color:var(--accent);}
  .qcard.open{border-color:var(--accent); box-shadow:inset 4px 0 0 var(--accent), var(--shadow);}
  .qcard.focused{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:1px;}
  .qhead{
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-start;
    gap:14px;
    padding:15px 18px;
    cursor:pointer;
    user-select:none;
  }
  .qcheck{
    margin-top:3px;
    flex:0 0 auto;
    width:20px;height:20px;
    border-radius:6px;
    border:1.5px solid var(--muted);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    cursor:pointer;
    background:var(--panel);
  }
  .qcheck:hover{border-color:var(--ok);}
  .qcheck.done{background:var(--ok); border-color:var(--ok);}
  .qcheck.done::after{content:"✓"; color:var(--panel); font-size:13px; font-weight:700;}
  .qmain{flex:1; min-width:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px;}
  .qtext{flex:1; font-size:16.5px; line-height:1.4; font-weight:700;}
  .qtext.done-text{color:var(--muted); font-weight:500;}
  .qchips{display:flex; gap:6px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .qsec,.qcore{font-size:12px; padding:1px 8px; border-radius:99px; border:1px solid var(--border); color:var(--muted); background:var(--panel-2);}
  .qcore{color:var(--gold); border-color:var(--gold); background:var(--gold-soft);}
  .qsum{font-size:14.5px; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.5; max-width:var(--measure);}
  .qcard.open .qsum{display:none;}
  .qchevron{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    color:var(--muted);
    font-size:20px;
    line-height:1;
    transform:rotate(0deg);
    transition:transform .15s ease;
    margin-top:2px;
  }
  .qcard.open .qchevron{transform:rotate(90deg); color:var(--accent);}
  .qbody{
    display:none;
    padding:2px 22px 22px 52px;
    border-top:1px solid var(--border);
    font-size:16px;
    line-height:1.65;
  }
  .qcard.open .qbody{display:block; padding-top:18px;}
  /* Prose keeps a readable line length; tables, code and diagrams may use the full card width. */
  .qbody > p, .qbody > ul, .qbody > ol, .qbody > blockquote, .qbody > .callout, .qbody > h3, .qbody > h4{max-width:var(--measure);}
  .qbody p{margin:0 0 14px;}
  .qbody ul, .qbody ol{margin:0 0 14px; padding-left:22px;}
  .qbody li{margin-bottom:7px;}
  .qbody li::marker{color:var(--accent);}
  .qbody strong{color:var(--text); font-weight:700;}
  .qbody h3, .qbody h4{font-family:var(--display); font-size:17px; margin:20px 0 8px; letter-spacing:-0.01em;}
  code{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    background:var(--code-bg);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:0 5px;
    border-radius:5px;
    font-size:0.875em;
    overflow-wrap:anywhere;
  }
  pre{
    font-family:var(--mono);
    background:var(--code-bg);
    color:var(--text);
    padding:14px 16px;
    border-radius:10px;
    overflow-x:auto;
    font-size:13.5px;
    line-height:1.65;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    tab-size:2;
  }
  pre code{background:none; border:0; padding:0; font-size:inherit;}
  /* syntax colouring added by the engine (comments, strings, keywords, numbers) */
  .tk-c{color:var(--muted); font-style:italic;}
  .tk-s{color:var(--ok);}
  .tk-k{color:var(--accent); font-weight:500;}
  .tk-n{color:var(--gold);}
  .diagram{
    background:var(--panel-2);
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius:12px;
    padding:16px;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    overflow-x:auto;
  }
  .diagram svg{display:block; margin:0 auto; max-width:100%; height:auto;}
  .diagram.lightbg{background:#F8FAFC; border-color:#CBD5E1;}
  .diagram.lightbg .codelabel{color:#334155;}
  .tag{
    display:inline-block;
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--gold);
    background:var(--gold-soft);
    border:1px solid var(--gold);
    border-radius:6px;
    padding:1px 7px;
    margin-bottom:10px;
  }
  .tscroll{overflow-x:auto; margin:0 0 16px;}
  .tscroll > table.cmp{margin:0;}
  table.cmp{
    width:100%;
    border-collapse:collapse;
    margin:0 0 16px;
    font-size:14.5px;
    line-height:1.5;
  }
  table.cmp th, table.cmp td{
    border:1px solid var(--border);
    padding:9px 12px;
    text-align:left;
    vertical-align:top;
  }
  table.cmp th{background:var(--panel-2); font-size:13.5px; font-weight:700;}
  table.cmp tr:nth-child(odd) td{background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--panel-2) 45%, transparent);}

  .tbadge{display:inline-block; font-size:12px; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold); background:var(--gold-soft); border:1px solid var(--gold); border-radius:99px; padding:2px 10px; margin-bottom:10px;}
  .deeper{margin-top:16px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px dashed var(--border); font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.9;}
  .deeper + .deeper{margin-top:2px; padding-top:0; border-top:0;}
  a.go{color:var(--accent); text-decoration:none; border-bottom:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent);}
  a.go:hover{border-bottom-color:var(--accent);}

  .search{width:100%; box-sizing:border-box; margin:0 0 14px; padding:10px 12px; font:inherit; font-size:14.5px; color:var(--text); background:var(--bg); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px;}
  .search::placeholder{color:var(--muted);}
  .search:focus{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:1px;}
  .qcheck:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset:2px;}
  mark{background:var(--gold-soft); color:var(--text); border-radius:3px; padding:0 2px;}
  .toolbar{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:10px 16px; margin:0 0 18px; font-size:14px; color:var(--muted);}
  .toolbar .tmeta{font-size:13.5px; margin-right:auto;}
  .toolbar .tgroup{display:flex; gap:10px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .toolbar button{font:inherit; font-size:13.5px; color:var(--text); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:6px 12px; cursor:pointer;}
  .toolbar button:hover{border-color:var(--accent); color:var(--accent);}
  .toolbar label{display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; cursor:pointer; white-space:nowrap;}
  .toolbar input{accent-color:var(--accent); width:15px; height:15px;}
  .empty{color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; padding:18px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:12px;}
  .pager{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; margin-top:28px;}
  .pager button{font:inherit; font-size:14.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--accent); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 16px; cursor:pointer; max-width:48%; text-align:left;}
  .pager button:last-child{text-align:right;}
  .pager button:hover{border-color:var(--accent); background:var(--accent-soft);}
  .back-btn{position:fixed; right:22px; bottom:22px; z-index:10; font:inherit; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-ink); background:var(--accent); border:0; border-radius:99px; padding:11px 18px; cursor:pointer; box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.22);}
  .keys{display:inline-block; margin-top:6px;}
  kbd{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:11.5px; padding:0 5px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-bottom-width:2px; border-radius:5px; background:var(--panel); color:var(--text);}
  .hero-actions{margin-top:18px; display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px;}
  .fc-start,.toolbar .flash-btn{font:inherit; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent-ink); background:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent); border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer;}
  .fc-start{font-size:15px; padding:10px 18px;}
  .toolbar .flash-btn{color:var(--accent-ink);}
  .toolbar .flash-btn:hover{color:var(--accent-ink);}
  .fc-start:hover,.toolbar .flash-btn:hover{filter:brightness(1.1);}
  button.fc-start.alt{background:var(--panel); color:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent);}
  button.fc-start.alt:hover{background:var(--accent-soft); filter:none;}
  a.fc-start.alt{display:inline-block; text-decoration:none; background:var(--panel); color:var(--accent); border:1px solid var(--accent);}

  /* ---------- Flashcards ---------- */
  body.fc-lock{overflow:hidden;}
  .fc{position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:50; background:rgba(8,14,26,.6); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; padding:24px;}
  .fc[hidden]{display:none;}
  .fc-dialog{width:min(920px,100%); max-height:100%; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:18px; box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4); outline:none;}
  .fc-head{display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:flex-start; gap:12px; padding:18px 22px 12px;}
  .fc-title{font-family:var(--display); font-size:17px; font-weight:700;}
  .fc-count{font-size:13px; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:var(--muted); margin-top:3px;}
  .fc-tools{display:flex; gap:12px; align-items:center; font-size:14px; color:var(--muted);}
  .fc-tools label{display:flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; cursor:pointer;}
  .fc-tools input{accent-color:var(--accent);}
  .fc-tools button{font:inherit; font-size:15px; color:var(--muted); background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; width:34px; height:34px; cursor:pointer;}
  .fc-bar{height:5px; background:var(--border); margin:0 22px; border-radius:99px; overflow:hidden;}
  .fc-bar i{display:block; height:100%; width:0; background:var(--ok); transition:width .2s ease;}
  .fc-body{flex:1; overflow-y:auto; padding:24px 26px; min-height:220px;}
  .fc-q{font-family:var(--display); font-size:25px; line-height:1.3; margin:12px 0 18px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:-0.015em; text-wrap:balance;}
  .fc-prompt{color:var(--muted); font-size:15px; border:1px dashed var(--border); border-radius:12px; padding:28px 18px; text-align:center;}
  .fc .qbody.fc-a{display:block; border-top:1px solid var(--border); padding:18px 0 0; font-size:16px;}
  .fc-done h3{font-family:var(--display); font-size:22px; margin:0 0 8px;}
  .fc-done .fc-sub{color:var(--muted); margin:14px 0 6px;}
  .fc-done ul{padding-left:20px; font-size:15px;}
  .fc-actions{display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:flex-end; padding:14px 22px; border-top:1px solid var(--border); flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .fc-actions button{font:inherit; font-size:15px; color:var(--text); background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px; padding:10px 18px; cursor:pointer;}
  .fc-actions button.primary{color:var(--accent-ink); background:var(--accent); border-color:var(--accent); font-weight:700;}
  .fc-actions button.again{border-color:var(--gold); color:var(--gold);}
  .fc-actions button:first-child{margin-right:auto;}
  .fc-actions kbd{margin-left:6px; background:transparent; border-color:currentColor; color:inherit; opacity:.8;}
  .fc-keys{font-size:12.5px; color:var(--muted); padding:0 22px 16px; text-align:right;}

  /* ---------- Answer building blocks ---------- */
  .lede{font-size:17px; color:var(--text); font-weight:500;}
  .callout{background:var(--accent-soft); border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); border-left:4px solid var(--accent); border-radius:10px; padding:12px 16px; margin:0 0 16px;}
  .callout.warning{background:var(--gold-soft); border-color:var(--gold);}
  .callout > :last-child{margin-bottom:0;}
  .note{font-size:14px; color:var(--muted);}
  .codelabel{font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--accent); margin:12px 0 5px;}
  .verified{font-size:13.5px; color:var(--muted); border-top:1px dashed var(--border); padding-top:8px; margin-top:12px;}
  .verified strong{color:var(--accent);}
  .keyline{font-family:var(--mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--accent);}
  .followup{border-left:3px solid var(--gold); padding-left:12px; color:var(--text);}
  .gcards{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(260px,1fr)); gap:12px; margin:0 0 16px;}
  .gcard{border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:12px; background:var(--panel-2); padding:14px 16px;}
  .gcard h3,.gcard h4{margin:0 0 6px; font-size:15px; font-family:var(--sans);}
  .gcard ul{margin:0; padding-left:18px;}
  .rail{display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:6px; margin:0 0 16px; font-size:14px;}
  .rail span{background:var(--panel-2); border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:6px 10px;}
  .rail span b{display:block; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--accent);}

      state = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (p: T) => T)(state) : next;
      listeners.forEach((l) => l());
    },
  };

      a:`<p>Production-grade API calls need request cancellation, retry logic for transient failures, and runtime type validation.</p><pre>import { z } from 'zod';

});

async function getUser(id: number, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<User> {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
    const res = await fetch(\`/api/users/\${id}\`, { signal });

    if (res.ok) {
      const data = await res.json();
      return UserSchema.parse(data); // runtime validation!
    }

      throw new Error(\`Client error: \${res.status}\`); // don't retry 4xx

    // Exponential backoff for 5xx
    await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000 * Math.pow(2, attempt)));

  if(typing || e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey) return;
  const list = cards();
  if(e.key === '/'){ e.preventDefault(); searchInput.focus(); searchInput.select(); return; }
  if(e.key === 'j' || e.key === 'k'){
    if(!list.length) return;
    focusIdx = Math.max(0, Math.min(list.length - 1, focusIdx + (e.key === 'j' ? 1 : -1)));
    setFocus(list[focusIdx], true); return;
  }
  const cur = list[focusIdx];
  if((e.key === 'o' || e.key === 'Enter') && cur){ cur.classList.toggle('open'); return; }
  if(e.key === 'x' && cur){ setDone(cur, !reviewed[qKey(cur.dataset.sec, Number(cur.dataset.q))]); return; }
  if(e.key === 'n' || e.key === 'p'){
    if(searchTerm) return;
    const i = DATA.findIndex(s=>s.id===activeId) + (e.key === 'n' ? 1 : -1);
    if(DATA[i]){ activeId = DATA[i].id; hideBack(); renderNav(); renderContent(); window.scrollTo(0,0); }
  }
});


// ---- flashcards: question first, say the answer, reveal, rate yourself
const fcEl = document.getElementById('fc');
const fc = { open:false, deck:[], i:0, revealed:false, got:0, missed:[], again:new Map(), title:'', source:[] };
function shuffleArr(a){ for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); const t=a[i]; a[i]=a[j]; a[j]=t; } return a; }
function startDeck(entries, title){
  if(!entries.length) return;
  fc.source = entries.slice();
  fc.deck = prefs.shuffle ? shuffleArr(entries.slice()) : entries.slice();
  fc.i = 0; fc.revealed = false; fc.got = 0; fc.missed = []; fc.again = new Map(); fc.title = title; fc.open = true;
  fc.opener = document.activeElement;   // restore focus here when the dialog closes
  fcEl.querySelector('#fcShuffle').checked = !!prefs.shuffle;
  fcEl.hidden = false; document.body.classList.add('fc-lock');
  renderFc();
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-dialog').focus();
}
function closeFc(){
  fc.open = false; fcEl.hidden = true; document.body.classList.remove('fc-lock');
  refreshWeakButton();
  const opener = fc.opener; fc.opener = null;
  if(searchTerm) renderSearch(); else renderContent();   // rebuilds #content, so `opener` may now be a detached node
  // Return focus to whatever opened the deck when it's still on the page (the hero "Flashcards"
  // buttons, outside #content, always survive this). Otherwise #content was just rebuilt under
  // the (now-detached) opener, so land on its heading instead of silently losing focus to <body>.
  if(opener && document.contains(opener)) opener.focus();
  else {
    const heading = content.querySelector('.section-head h2') || content.querySelector('.section-head');
    if(heading){ heading.setAttribute('tabindex', '-1'); heading.focus(); }
  }
}
function markReviewed(key, val){ reviewed[key] = val; writeJSON(STORAGE_KEY, reviewed); const p = key.split(':'); syncTitle(p[0], Number(p[1]), val); updateProgress(); renderNav(); }
function renderFc(){
  const n = fc.deck.length;
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-title').textContent = fc.title;
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-count').textContent = (fc.i < n ? (fc.i + 1) : n) + ' / ' + n + (fc.got ? ' · ' + fc.got + ' got it' : '') + (fc.missed.length ? ' · ' + new Set(fc.missed).size + ' to revisit' : '');
  fcEl.querySelector('.fc-bar i').style.width = (n ? fc.i / n * 100 : 0) + '%';
  const body = fcEl.querySelector('.fc-body');
  const actions = fcEl.querySelector('.fc-actions');
  if(fc.i >= n){
    const uniqMissed = Array.from(new Set(fc.missed));
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="fc-done"><h3>Deck finished</h3><p>' + fc.got + ' marked "got it" (and ticked as reviewed) · ' + uniqMissed.length + ' to revisit.</p>' +
      (uniqMissed.length ? '<p class="fc-sub">To revisit:</p><ul>' + uniqMissed.map(e=>'<li>' + e.item.q + '</li>').join('') + '</ul>' : '<p class="fc-sub">Nothing missed. Well done.</p>') + '</div>';
    actions.innerHTML = (uniqMissed.length ? '<button data-fc="missed" class="primary">Practise the ' + uniqMissed.length + ' missed</button>' : '') +
      '<button data-fc="restart">Restart deck</button><button data-fc="close">Close <kbd>Esc</kbd></button>';
    return;
  }
  const e = fc.deck[fc.i];
  const key = qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx);
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="qchips"><span class="qsec">' + e.section.title + '</span>' + (CORE.has(key) ? '<span class="qcore">★ core</span>' : '') + (reviewed[key] ? '<span class="qsec">reviewed</span>' : '') + '</div>' +
    '<h3 class="fc-q">' + e.item.q + '</h3>' +
    (fc.revealed ? '<div class="qbody fc-a">' + e.item.a + '</div>' : '<p class="fc-prompt">Answer it out loud first: the main point, one example, one trade-off. Then reveal.</p>');
  enhance(body);
  body.scrollTop = 0;
  actions.innerHTML = fc.revealed
    ? '<button data-fc="prev" title="Previous (←)">←</button><button data-fc="again" class="again">Again <kbd>1</kbd></button><button data-fc="got" class="primary">Got it <kbd>2</kbd></button>'
    : '<button data-fc="prev" title="Previous (←)">←</button><button data-fc="reveal" class="primary">Reveal answer <kbd>Space</kbd></button><button data-fc="skip">Skip <kbd>→</kbd></button>';
}
function fcAction(act){
  const n = fc.deck.length, e = fc.deck[fc.i];
  if(act === 'close') return closeFc();
  if(act === 'restart') return startDeck(fc.source, fc.title);
  if(act === 'missed') return startDeck(Array.from(new Set(fc.missed)), fc.title + ' · missed');
  if(fc.i >= n && act !== 'prev') return;
  if(act === 'reveal'){ fc.revealed = !fc.revealed; }
  else if(act === 'got'){ if(!fc.revealed){ fc.revealed = true; } else { markReviewed(qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx), true); markWeak(e.tkey, false); fc.got++; fc.i++; fc.revealed = false; } }
  else if(act === 'again'){
    if(!fc.revealed){ fc.revealed = true; }
    else {
      const k = qKey(e.section.id, e.qIdx), times = fc.again.get(k) || 0;
      fc.missed.push(e);
      markWeak(e.tkey, true);
      if(times < 2){ fc.deck.push(e); fc.again.set(k, times + 1); }   // comes back later in this session
      fc.i++; fc.revealed = false;
    }
  }
  else if(act === 'skip'){ fc.i++; fc.revealed = false; }
  else if(act === 'prev'){ if(fc.i > 0){ fc.i--; fc.revealed = false; } }
  renderFc();
}
fcEl.addEventListener('click', (e)=>{
  if(e.target === fcEl) return closeFc();
  const b = e.target.closest('button[data-fc]');
  if(b) return fcAction(b.dataset.fc);
  const a = e.target.closest('a[data-go]');
  if(a){ e.preventDefault(); closeFc(); const p = a.dataset.go.split(':'); gotoQuestion(p[0], Number(p[1]), true); }
});
fcEl.querySelector('#fcShuffle').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
  prefs.shuffle = e.target.checked; savePrefs();
  const keep = fc.i + (fc.revealed ? 1 : 0);
  const rest = fc.deck.slice(keep);
  if(prefs.shuffle) shuffleArr(rest);
  fc.deck = fc.deck.slice(0, keep).concat(rest);
  renderFc();
});
function fcFocusables(){
  return Array.from(fcEl.querySelectorAll('button, input, a[href], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])')).filter((el) => !el.disabled && el.offsetParent !== null);
}
function fcKey(e){
  if(e.key === 'Escape'){ e.preventDefault(); closeFc(); return; }
  if(e.key === 'Tab'){
    // trap focus inside the dialog: wrap from the last focusable back to the first, and vice versa
    const items = fcFocusables();
    if(!items.length) return;
    const idx = items.indexOf(document.activeElement);
    const next = e.shiftKey ? (idx <= 0 ? items.length - 1 : idx - 1) : (idx === items.length - 1 ? 0 : idx + 1);
    e.preventDefault();
    items[next].focus();
    return;
  }
  if(e.target && e.target.id === 'fcShuffle') return;
  const map = { ' ':'reveal', 'Enter':'reveal', '1':'again', '2':'got', 'ArrowRight':'skip', 'ArrowLeft':'prev' };
  const act = map[e.key];
  if(!act) return;
  if(e.target && e.target.tagName === 'BUTTON' && (e.key === ' ' || e.key === 'Enter')) return;   // let a focused button click itself
  e.preventDefault();
  if(fc.i >= fc.deck.length && act !== 'prev') return;
  fcAction(act);
}
function deckFromView(){ return cards().map(c=> entry(c.dataset.sec, Number(c.dataset.q))); }
document.getElementById('fcCore').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(CORE.size) startDeck(Array.from(CORE).map(k=>{ const p = k.split(':'); return entry(p[0], Number(p[1])); }).filter(Boolean), 'All ★ core questions');
  else startDeck(INDEX.filter(e=>e.section.id!=='quickref'), 'All questions');
});

// ---- weak cards: any card marked "Again" (anywhere, including another guide), still unresolved
const fcWeakBtn = document.getElementById('fcWeak');
function weakOnThisGuide(){ return INDEX.filter(e=> weak[e.tkey]); }
function refreshWeakButton(){
  if(!fcWeakBtn) return;
  const n = weakOnThisGuide().length;
  fcWeakBtn.hidden = n === 0;
  fcWeakBtn.textContent = '↻ Review ' + n + ' weak card' + (n===1?'':'s');
}
function startWeakDeck(){
  if(fc.open) return;   // the #weak deep link retries its message for a few seconds; ignore repeats once the deck is open, or every retry would reset the user's progress in it
  const list = weakOnThisGuide();
  if(list.length) startDeck(list, 'Weak cards');
}
if(fcWeakBtn) fcWeakBtn.addEventListener('click', startWeakDeck);
refreshWeakButton();
window.addEventListener('storage', (e)=>{ if(e.key === WEAK_KEY){ weak = readJSON(WEAK_KEY, {}); refreshWeakButton(); } });

document.getElementById('resetBtn').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
  if(!confirm('Clear all reviewed checkmarks?')) return;
  reviewed = {}; writeJSON(STORAGE_KEY, reviewed);
  INDEX.forEach(e=>{ delete titleDone[e.tkey]; }); writeJSON(TITLES_KEY, titleDone);
  renderNav(); renderContent(); updateProgress();
});

document.getElementById('heroMeta').textContent = DATA.length + ' sections · ' + totalQuestions() + ' questions' + (CORE.size ? ' · ' + CORE.size + ' marked ★ core (linked from ' + window.__STUDY__.core + ')' : '');
document.getElementById('fcCore').textContent = CORE.size ? '▶ Flashcards: all ★ core questions' : '▶ Flashcards: all ' + INDEX.filter(e=>e.section.id!=='quickref').length + ' questions';
renderNav();
renderContent();
updateProgress();
</script>
